-73.76120,41.02620.name: Westchester Fertility & Reproductive Endocrinology
-73.76120,41.02620.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Michael B. Blotner, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

121.60712,25.05301.name: Biomedical Translation Research Center
121.60712,25.05301.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Part of Academia Sinica. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-5.95403,54.59424.name: Regional Fertility Centre, Belfast
-5.95403,54.59424.state: Royal Maternity Hospital, Grosvenor Road, Belfast, BT12 6BA, United Kingdom
-5.95403,54.59424.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

151.20700,-33.87600.name: Virtus Health
151.20700,-33.87600.desc: One of Australia’s largest fertility groups, listed and then taken private by an investment firm. Private equity ownership of fertility clinics is spreading across several countries, and the return expectations of that ownership sit behind decisions about cycle pricing, add-on offerings and which patients are accepted.

-73.99000,40.74000.name: Nucleus Genomics
-73.99000,40.74000.desc: Sells polygenic scoring of IVF embryos, including for traits with no medical meaning, and has advertised it that way. Polygenic prediction for complex traits is weak at the individual level even where the statistics are sound, and the professional bodies have said so; the service is sold anyway, because nothing prohibits it. This is embryo selection marketed as a consumer product.

-90.33000,38.65000.name: Bunge
-90.33000,38.65000.desc: One of the four traders — with Cargill, ADM and Louis Dreyfus — that move most of the world’s grain and oilseeds. These four decide what is worth growing more directly than any seed company: a variety nobody will buy does not get planted whatever its traits. Three of the four are private or family-controlled and disclose far less than any listed seed company on this map.
